a. The two systems of placing dimensions are **Aligned system** and **Unidirectional system**.
b. **Extension line:** A thin continuous line drawn from the outline of an object to indicate the limits of a dimension.
c. **Uses of margins:** Margins provide a clean boundary, protect the drawing edges from damage during handling, and leave space for binding the drawing sheets.
d. Ratio of the length of drawing and object is called **Representative Factor (RF)** or scale.
e. **Dimension of an arrow:** Typically, the length to width ratio of an arrowhead in engineering drawing is kept as **3:1** (e.g., length $3\text{ mm}$ and width $1\text{ mm}$).
proTip: Make sure to memorize standard arrowhead proportions (3:1) and the two primary dimensioning systems.
